title: Scribe Edit Distance Correction
statement:
An apprentice scribe copies an ancient incantation string S1, but inadvertently introduces transcription errors, yielding string S2.

To restore the incantation, the head scribe can perform three atomic operations:
1. Insert a character.
2. Delete a character.
3. Replace a character with another.

Calculate the minimum number of edit operations required to transform S1 into S2.
inputFormat:
First line: String S1.
Second line: String S2.
constraints:
1 <= len(S1), len(S2) <= 1000
Strings contain lowercase English letters.

sampleCases.explanation: horse -> rorse (replace h with r) -> rose (remove r) -> ros (remove e).
